title: Travel 2
note: Journeys, problems and accommodation, above leaf_travel_a2 (holidays). leaf_knowledge_b1 is titled Knowledge & travel but only half-covers this - keep them apart. First draft 2026-09-02, rough. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma (B22 quiz_mode sentence_gap was already set, but 28 of the 36 words had no frame to gap). · E10: Use is no longer CZ→EN of the bank — use_mode rewrite, 12 underlined paraphrases that make the student produce the new word. · E1/E4: every frame is a situation someone would actually say; no X is very important. · F6: people and places rotated (Petr, Ostrava, Telč, Rome, Vienna), no repeat of Anna/Brno. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_travel_b1 — 0 unknown types. James smoke 2026-09-04: F8/C57 recap card added (Travel 1 reminder, four tiles not the full set; luggage/booking/backpack are the only repeats). Four rewrite items had an underline that did not cover what actually changes, so a correct rewrite was marked wrong. Bad weather no longer closes the airport as its subject.

intro.title: You already know
intro.note: Travel 1 gave you the trip (journey, tour, abroad, destination), the bags and paper (luggage, passport, ticket, booking) and where you stay (hostel, camping, countryside). Luggage, booking and backpack come back here — the rest of this unit is new: what goes wrong, and what you do about it.
intro.note_cz: Travel 1 dal cestu (journey, tour, abroad, destination), zavazadla a doklady (luggage, passport, ticket, booking) a kde bydlíš (hostel, camping, countryside). Luggage, booking a backpack se sem vracejí — zbytek je nový: co se pokazí a co s tím uděláš.

intro.title: You will use these words in

sentences.en: Our flight had a long delay because the weather was bad in Vienna.
sentences.cz: Náš let měl velké zpoždění, protože ve Vídni bylo špatné počasí.
accepts: Our flight had a long delay because the weather was bad in Vienna

sentences.en: The airline lost my luggage, which arrived three days later.
sentences.cz: Aerolinky mi ztratily zavazadlo, které dorazilo o tři dny později.
accepts: The airline lost my luggage, which arrived three days later

sentences.en: We had to cancel the trip because my daughter was ill.
sentences.cz: Museli jsme ten výlet zrušit, protože byla dcera nemocná.
accepts: We had to cancel the trip because my daughter was ill

sentences.en: The accommodation was cheaper than the hotel we found online.
sentences.cz: Ubytování bylo levnější než hotel, který jsme našli na internetu.
accepts: The accommodation was cheaper than the hotel we found online

sentences.en: I missed my connection in Vienna because the first train left late.
sentences.cz: Ve Vídni jsem zmeškal přípoj, protože první vlak jel pozdě.
accepts: I missed my connection in Vienna because the first train left late

sentences.en: They gave us a full refund after we wrote to the company.
sentences.cz: Vrátili nám všechny peníze poté, co jsme napsali firmě.
accepts: They gave us a full refund after we wrote to the company

sentences.en: We check in at the hotel as soon as we arrive from the airport.
sentences.cz: Ubytujeme se v hotelu, jakmile přijedeme z letiště.
accepts: We check in at the hotel as soon as we arrive from the airport

sentences.en: Travel insurance is cheaper if you buy it before the holiday starts.
sentences.cz: Cestovní pojištění je levnější, když si ho koupíš před začátkem dovolené.
accepts: Travel insurance is cheaper if you buy it before the holiday starts

sentences.en: I keep my boarding pass on my phone.
sentences.cz: Palubní lístek mám v telefonu.
accepts: I keep my boarding pass on my phone

sentences.en: We waited at baggage claim for twenty minutes.
sentences.cz: U výdeje zavazadel jsme čekali dvacet minut.
accepts: We waited at baggage claim for twenty minutes

sentences.en: The train to Ostrava leaves from platform four.
sentences.cz: Vlak do Ostravy odjíždí ze čtvrtého nástupiště.
accepts: The train to Ostrava leaves from platform four

sentences.en: Petr takes everything in one small backpack.
sentences.cz: Petr si všechno bere v jednom malém batohu.
accepts: Petr takes everything in one small backpack

sentences.en: Passport control took longer than we expected.
sentences.cz: Pasová kontrola trvala déle, než jsme čekali.
accepts: Passport control took longer than we expected

sentences.en: The transfer from the airport takes an hour.
sentences.cz: Přesun z letiště trvá hodinu.
accepts: The transfer from the airport takes an hour

sentences.en: This route is faster, but the road is worse.
sentences.cz: Tahle trasa je rychlejší, ale silnice je horší.
accepts: This route is faster, but the road is worse

sentences.en: We took the ferry because the road was closed.
sentences.cz: Jeli jsme trajektem, protože silnice byla zavřená.
accepts: We took the ferry because the road was closed

sentences.en: Car hire is cheaper at the station than at the airport.
sentences.cz: Půjčovna aut je levnější na nádraží než na letišti.
accepts: Car hire is cheaper at the station than at the airport

sentences.en: If we walk slowly, we will miss the train.
sentences.cz: Když půjdeme pomalu, zmeškáme vlak.
accepts: If we walk slowly, we will miss the train
If we walk slowly, we'll miss the train

sentences.en: Tourists often get lost in the old town.
sentences.cz: Turisté se ve starém městě často ztratí.
accepts: Tourists often get lost in the old town

sentences.en: Call this number only in an emergency.
sentences.cz: Na tohle číslo volej jen v nouzové situaci.
accepts: Call this number only in an emergency

sentences.en: She wrote to the airline about her lost luggage.
sentences.cz: Napsala aerolinkám kvůli ztracenému zavazadlu.

sentences.en: My son gets travel sick on the bus.
sentences.cz: Můj syn má v autobuse cestovní nevolnost.
accepts: My son gets travel sick on the bus

sentences.en: The strike stopped every train for two days.
sentences.cz: Stávka na dva dny zastavila všechny vlaky.
accepts: The strike stopped every train for two days

sentences.en: The airport was closed on Sunday morning because of bad weather.
sentences.cz: Letiště bylo v neděli ráno zavřené kvůli špatnému počasí.
accepts: The airport was closed on Sunday morning because of bad weather

sentences.en: I want to complain about our room.
sentences.cz: Chci si stěžovat na náš pokoj.
accepts: I want to complain about our room

sentences.en: Her phone was stolen on the night bus.
sentences.cz: Telefon jí ukradli v nočním autobuse.
accepts: Her phone was stolen on the night bus

sentences.en: We asked for a double room near the garden.
sentences.cz: Požádali jsme o dvoulůžkový pokoj blízko zahrady.
accepts: We asked for a double room near the garden

sentences.en: You have to check out before eleven o'clock.
sentences.cz: Musíš se odhlásit před jedenáctou hodinou.
accepts: You have to check out before eleven o'clock

sentences.en: I always look for a hotel with breakfast included.
sentences.cz: Vždycky hledám hotel se snídaní v ceně.
accepts: I always look for a hotel with breakfast included

sentences.en: The campsite near the lake was full in July.
sentences.cz: Kemp u jezera byl v červenci plný.

sentences.en: They stayed in a small guest house in Telč.

sentences.en: I read every review before I book a room.
sentences.cz: Přečtu si každou recenzi, než si zamluvím pokoj.

sentences.en: The wifi in the room stopped working at night.
sentences.cz: Wifi na pokoji v noci přestala fungovat.
accepts: The wifi in the room stopped working at night

sentences.en: We paid a deposit when we booked the flat.
sentences.cz: Když jsme si zamluvili byt, zaplatili jsme zálohu.

sentences.en: My booking was for Friday, not for Saturday.

sentences.en: The receptionist gave us a map of the city.
sentences.cz: Recepční nám dal mapu města.
accepts: The receptionist gave us a map of the city
